title: OpenAPI Document Contract
description: Structural requirements for all compiled OpenAPI 3.1 documents

rules.title: Info Complete
rules.description: info object must have title, version, and description. contact.email is required.

rules.title: Errors Documented
rules.description: Every path operation must document at least: 400 (if POST/PUT/PATCH), 401 (if secured), 500

rules.title: No Empty Paths
rules.description: Every path in paths must have at least one HTTP method defined

rules.title: Operation IDs
rules.description: Every operation must have a unique operationId in camelCase

rules.title: Response Schemas
rules.description: All 2xx responses must have a content schema. 204 (No Content) is the only exception.

rules.title: Servers Defined
rules.description: servers[] must have at least one entry with a url

rules.title: Security Declared
rules.description: Either global security is declared or every protected operation has security declared at operation level
